::: {.product-interpretation}
This map subtracts the 30-day precipitation percentile rank from 14 days ago from today's 30-day rank, using each date's matching 1991-2020 seasonal sample. Positive percentile-point changes show relative wetting and negative changes show relative drying, rather than a change in precipitation inches.
:::
